# Banana Prompts

> > Banana Prompts is a comprehensive platform for AI image generation featuring the Nano Banana prompt methodology, image-to-prompt tools, and curated templates for Midjourney, DALL-E 3, and Stable Diffusion.

The site specializes in the Nano Banana technique—a 4-step framework for creating photorealistic AI images—and provides both educational guides and practical tools for prompt engineering. It offers multilingual support and covers diverse styles from Dark Academia to anime transformations.

## Key Topics

- Nano Banana methodology
- Image-to-prompt reverse engineering
- Midjourney prompts
- DALL-E 3 templates
- Stable Diffusion
- Prompt engineering
- AI image generation
- Photorealistic rendering
- Dark Academia style
- Anime-to-real transformation
- Prompt templates
- Image analysis
- Nano Banana Pro
- Copy-paste prompts

## Core Tools & Features

- [Image to Prompt - Generate AI Prompts from Any Image](https://bananaprompts.org/image-to-prompt): Tool to reverse-engineer AI prompts from images for generation models
- [Banana Prompts: Ontdek Kwaliteitsprompts Voor Beeldgeneratie](https://bananaprompts.org/nl): Dutch homepage: Nano Banana prompt templates for AI image generation
- [Banana Prompts: Entdecke Hochwertige Prompts Für Bildgenerierung](https://bananaprompts.org/de): German homepage: Nano Banana prompt library for AI image generation
- [Image vers Prompt - Générez des Prompts IA à partir de N'importe Quelle Image](https://bananaprompts.org/fr/image-to-prompt): French version: Image-to-prompt tool for Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion

## Nano Banana Methodology

- [Nano Banana Prompt Guide](https://bananaprompts.org/blog/nano-banana-prompt-guide): 4-step Nano Banana guide for photorealistic AI image generation

## Prompt Guides & Tutorials

- [The 2025 Christmas AI Art Guide: Copy-Paste Prompts for Midjourney & DALL-E 3](https://bananaprompts.org/blog/ultimate-christmas-ai-prompt-guide-2025): Christmas AI prompts for Midjourney & DALL-E 3 with copy-paste templates
- [Explore 6 Unique AI Transformations: From Academia to Anime Reality](https://bananaprompts.org/blog/explore-6-unique-ai-transformations): Guide to 6 AI image styles: Dark Academia, Gundam mecha, anime-to-real
